- `@@ path/to/file.py`: replace the whole file with the body.

205|     def _get_select_menu(self):
206|         # handles modifying the select menu if more than 25 pages are provided
207|         # this will show the previous 12 and next 13 pages in the select menu
208|         # based on the currently displayed page. Once you reach close to the max
209|         # pages it will display the last 25 pages.
210|         if len(self.select_options) > 25:
211|             minus_diff = None
212|             plus_diff = 25
213|             if 12 < self.current_page < len(self.select_options) - 25:
214|                 minus_diff = self.current_page - 12
215|                 plus_diff = self.current_page + 13
216|             elif self.current_page >= len(self.select_options) - 25:
217|                 minus_diff = len(self.select_options) - 25
218|                 plus_diff = None
219|             options = self.select_options[minus_diff:plus_diff]
220|         else:
221|             options = self.select_options[:25]
222|         return _SelectMenu(options)

224|     async def start(self, ctx: Context, *, ephemeral: bool = False):

228|         Parameters
229|         ----------

232|             ephemeral: `bool`
233|                 Send the message ephemerally. This only works
234|                 if the context is from a slash command interaction.
235|         """
236|         self.author = ctx.author
237|         self.ctx = ctx
238|         kwargs = await self.get_page(self.current_page)
239|         self.message = await ctx.send(**kwargs, ephemeral=ephemeral)

241|     async def get_page(self, page_num: int) -> Dict[str, Optional[Any]]:
242|         try:
243|             page = await self.source.get_page(page_num)
244|         except IndexError:
245|             self.current_page = 0
246|             page = await self.source.get_page(self.current_page)
247|         value = await self.source.format_page(self, page)
248|         if self.use_select_menu and len(self.select_options) > 25 and self.source.is_paginating():
249|             self.remove_item(self.select_menu)
250|             self.select_menu = self._get_select_menu()
251|             self.add_item(self.select_menu)
252|         ret: Dict[str, Optional[Any]] = {"view": self}
253|         if isinstance(value, dict):
254|             ret.update(value)
255|         elif isinstance(value, str):
256|             ret.update({"content": value, "embed": None})
257|         elif isinstance(value, discord.Embed):
258|             ret.update({"embed": value, "content": None})
259|         return ret

265|             await interaction.response.send_message(
266|                 content=_("You are not authorized to interact with this."), ephemeral=True
267|             )
268|             return False
